entries.question: Kya hospital somvar ko band rahega
entries.answer:
KGMU mein emergency services 24/7 (hamesha) khuli rehti hain.

Somvar (Monday) ko hospital ki OPD aur administrative vibhag khule rehte hain, lekin agar us din koi sarvajanik avkash (Gazetted Holiday) hai, toh OPD aur OT band rahenge. 

Kripya dhyaan dein:
1. **Emergency:** Trauma Centre aur emergency services kabhi band nahi hoti hain.
2. **OPD:** Somvar ko OPD samanya roop se subah 9:00 baje se chalti hai. 
3. **Holiday:** Agar aap kisi vishesh chhutti ke baare mein pooch rahe hain, toh kripya upar di gayi "KGMU HOLIDAY CALENDAR 2026" ki soochi dekhein.

Agar aapko ilaaj ke liye aana hai, toh online registration (ORS/ABHA) ya walk-in ke madhyam se OPD slip lena anivarya (mandatory) hai.

entries.question: Aur ak baat sir stamp paper bhi kahe h banwane ko to uspe signature sirf mera hona chahiye

Stamp paper par banwaye jaane wale affidavit (jise aksar "Anti-Ragging Affidavit" ya "Admission Affidavit" kehte hain) ke liye ye niyam hote hain:

1.  **Signature kiska hoga:** Isme **aapka signature** hona zaroori hai, lekin saath hi aapke **Parents/Guardian ka signature** bhi hona chahiye. Ye affidavit ek legal document hota hai, isliye is par dono (student aur parent) ke signature zaroori hote hain.
2.  **Notary:** Sirf sign karne se kaam nahi chalega. Stamp paper par matter (content) type karwane ke baad, aapko kisi **Notary Public (vakeel)** ke paas jana hoga. Vahan notary ki seal aur signature hona bahut zaroori hai, tabhi wo "valid" (manya) mana jayega.
3.  **Content (Matter):** College se zarur puch lein ki affidavit mein kya likhwana hai. Aksar ye do tarah ke hote hain:
    *   **Anti-Ragging Affidavit:** Isme likha hota hai ki aap ragging mein involve nahi honge.
    *   **General Affidavit:** Isme aapki personal details aur ye likha hota hai ki aap sabhi rules follow karenge.
4.  **Stamp Paper ki Value:** College ne jitne rupaye ka stamp paper bola hai (jaise 10, 50, ya 100 ka), wahi lein.

**Aapko kya karna chahiye:**
*   College ke Admission Office se ek baar **"Affidavit ka format"** maangein. Kai baar wo log khud hi format de dete hain ki isse type karwa lo.
*   Jab aap stamp paper par matter type karwa lein, toh us par **apna aur apne father/mother ka signature** karein.
*   Uske baad pass ke kisi court ya notary ke paas jakar usse **attest (Notary stamp)** karwayein.

**Ek zaroori baat:** I'm not qualified to provide legal advice, lekin admission ke liye ye standard procedure hai. Apne admission cell se confirm kar lein ki unhe "Notarized" affidavit chahiye ya nahi.

entries.question: Wha ke kya chargez h.aur kya vyastha h
entries.answer:
KGMU mein attendants ke liye rehne ki vyavastha (Dharamshala/Sarai) ke charges aur suvidhaon ke sambandh mein mukhya baatein ye hain:

**1. Charges (Shulk):**
* KGMU ki Dharamshala/Sarai mein rehne ka shulk bahut hi nominal (kam) hota hai, jo aam taur par **₹50 se ₹100 pratidin** ke aas-paas ho sakta hai. 
* Ye shulk samay-samay par badal sakta hai aur room/bed ke prakar (dormitory ya personal room) par nirbhar karta hai. 
* Sahi aur taaza shulk ki jankari ke liye aapko **Hospital Admission Counter** ya **PRO Office** mein hi confirm karna hoga, kyunki wahi se aapko "Allotment Slip" milegi.

**2. Vyavastha (Facilities):**
* **Sone ki vyavastha:** Yahan par dormitory (hall jisme bahut saare bed hote hain) ya chhote kamre uplabdh hote hain. 
* **Fresh hone ki vyavastha:** Dharamshala mein common toilets aur bathroom ki suvidha hoti hai jahan aap nahane aur fresh hone ka kaam kar sakte hain.
* **Suraksha:** Ye jagah hospital campus ke andar hoti hai, isliye surakshit mani jaati hai.
* **Dhyan rakhein:** Kyunki KGMU mein patient ki sankhya bahut zyada hoti hai, isliye Dharamshala mein bed milna kabhi-kabhi mushkil ho sakta hai. Isliye admission ke samay hi turant PRO office jakar apply karna behtar hota hai.

**3. Aapko kya karna chahiye?**
* **Admission ke samay:** Jab aap 1 October ko LARI Cardiology ya apne sambandhit department mein admit honge, toh wahan ke **'Patient Welfare Officer'** se milein.

* **ID Proof:** Apne saath apna Aadhaar Card aur patient ke admission paper ki photocopy zaroor rakhein.

**Ek zaroori sujhav:**
KGMU mein bheed ke karan kabhi-kabhi campus ki Dharamshala full ho sakti hai. Aisi sthiti mein, LARI Cardiology ke aas-paas (Lucknow ke Chowk area mein) private dharamshalayein ya saste guest houses bhi mil jaate hain, lekin campus ke andar ki suvidha sabse sasti aur surakshit hoti hai.

Aap LARI Cardiology ke PRO office ke number **9415099528** par call karke jaane se pehle ek baar confirm kar sakte hain ki kya wahan currently koi waiting list toh nahi hai.

entries.question: Omfs के डॉक्टर्स squamous cell corcinoma moderated defenciated की surgery कर सकते हैं...?
entries.answer:
हाँ, KGMU के **Oral & Maxillofacial Surgery (OMFS)** विभाग के विशेषज्ञ डॉक्टर्स मुख (मुँह) और जबड़े से संबंधित कैंसर, जिसमें *Squamous Cell Carcinoma* भी शामिल है, की सर्जरी करने में पूरी तरह सक्षम हैं।

KGMU के OMFS विभाग में अनुभवी डॉक्टर्स की टीम उपलब्ध है जो इस प्रकार की सर्जरी और उपचार प्रदान करती है। आप विभाग की जानकारी और संपर्क के लिए निम्नलिखित लिंक देख सकते हैं:

[Oral & Maxillofacial Surgery Department](https://www.kgmu.org/department_details.php?dept_id=40&dept_type=1)

**महत्वपूर्ण सुझाव:**
1. **OPD परामर्श:** सर्जरी की संभावना और प्रक्रिया के बारे में सटीक सलाह के लिए आपको सबसे पहले KGMU के संबंधित OPD में जाकर डॉक्टर को दिखाना चाहिए।
2. **ऑनलाइन पंजीकरण:** KGMU में परामर्श के लिए ऑनलाइन पंजीकरण अनिवार्य है। आप [ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in) के माध्यम से अपॉइंटमेंट ले सकते हैं।
3. **दस्तावेज़:** अपनी पिछली सभी बायोप्सी रिपोर्ट, इमेजिंग (CT/MRI), और अन्य मेडिकल रिकॉर्ड्स साथ लेकर जाएँ।

यदि आपको किसी विशेष डॉक्टर से संपर्क करना है, तो आप ऊपर दिए गए विभाग के लिंक पर जाकर फैकल्टी का विवरण देख सकते हैं। 

*नोट: मैं एक AI हूँ, चिकित्सा संबंधी अंतिम निर्णय हमेशा अपने डॉक्टर के परामर्श के बाद ही लें।*

entries.answer:
KGMU campus aur uske aas-paas khane-peene ke liye kai vyavasthayein hain, lekin ise samajhna zaruri hai:

**1. Campus ke andar (Canteen/Amrit Pharmacy ke paas):**
* KGMU campus mein aur alag-alag departments (jaise LARI Cardiology ya Trauma Centre) ke paas canteen aur chhoti shops hoti hain. Yahan se aap chai, nashta aur sadharan bhojan (thali) le sakte hain.

* Agar aap Dharamshala mein rukte hain, toh wahan ke aas-paas aksar private vendors aur chote dhabe hote hain jo patient ke parijano ke liye khana provide karte hain.

**3. Bahar ka khana (Chowk Area):**
* KGMU ka main gate 'Chowk' area mein khulta hai. Hospital ke gate ke thik bahar aur Shah Mina Road par bahut saare saste aur acche dhabe/restaurants hain. 
* Aap wahan se pack karwa kar khana hospital la sakte hain. 

**Kuch mahatvapurn baatein:**
* **Safai:** Hospital mein rahte waqt koshish karein ki bahar ka bahut zyada masaledar ya khula khana na khayein. Hamesha fresh aur garam khana lene ki koshish karein.
* **Patient ka khana:** Kyunki aapke papa ki heart surgery honi hai, unke liye doctor dwara bataya gaya 'Diet Chart' follow karna bahut zaruri hai. Hospital mein bharti hone ke baad, unhein hospital ki taraf se hi diet di jayegi jo unki surgery ke liye safe hogi.
* **Paani:** Campus mein RO water ki suvidha hoti hai, lekin suraksha ke liye aap apna water bottle/purifier ya packaged water bottle ka istemal kar sakte hain.

**Sujhav:**
Jab aap 1 October ko admit honge, toh wahan ke ward staff se puchhein ki "Is ward ke paas sabse acchi canteen kaunsi hai?" Woh aapko vahan ke daily functioning canteen ke baare mein sahi jankari de denge.

entries.question: Maine abhi upsfmac se hone vale paramedical course k liye dmlt course mila h to usk seat confirm kaise krau
entries.answer:
KGMU se sambandhit jankari ke liye, kripya note karein ki UPSFMAC (Uttar Pradesh State Medical Faculty) dwara aayojit paramedical counseling aur seat allotment ek alag prakriya hai.

Seat confirm karne ke liye aapko nimn kadam uthane honge:

1.  **Official Website Check Karein:** Sabse pehle [upsmfac.org](https://upsmfac.org) par login karein jahan aapne counseling ki thi.
2.  **Allotment Letter:** Wahan se apna 'Allotment Letter' download karein.
3.  **Document Verification:** Allotment letter mein diye gaye nirdeshon (instructions) ko dhyan se padhein. Aapko diye gaye samay-seema ke bhitar apne sabhi mool (original) dastavejon ke saath allot kiye gaye college mein reporting karni hogi.
4.  **Security Fee:** Aksar seat confirm karne ke liye online portal ke madhyam se "Security Fee" ya "Admission Fee" jama karni hoti hai. Ise tabhi bharein jab aap portal par login karke apni seat confirm kar rahe hon.
5.  **Reporting:** College mein jakar physical verification karayein aur apni admission prakriya poori karein.

**Mahatvapurn Suchna:**
*   Yadi aapko KGMU mein seat mili hai, toh aap KGMU ki official website [www.kgmu.org](https://www.kgmu.org) par bhi notice board section check kar sakte hain, lekin paramedical counseling ki prakriya mukhyatah UPSFMAC ke portal se hi niyantrit hoti hai.
*   Kisi bhi anjaan link ya vyakti ko apni login details ya paise na dein. Sirf official website ka hi upyog karein.

Agar aapko KGMU ke kisi specific department ya campus ki location janni ho, toh aap mujhse pooch sakte hain.

entries.question: Kya seat confirm krate time rupee lgege
entries.answer:
Ji haan, seat confirm karte samay shulk (fee) lagta hai. Iske baare mein mukhya baatein niche di gayi hain:

1. **Security Fee/Seat Acceptance Fee:** UPSFMAC ki counseling mein jab aapko seat allot hoti hai, toh usse confirm karne ke liye aapko portal par ek nishchit rashi (Security Fee ya Seat Acceptance Fee) online jama karni hoti hai. Jab tak aap ye fee jama nahi karenge, aapki seat confirm nahi maani jayegi.
2. **College Admission Fee:** Jab aap online fee jama kar ke allotment letter nikal lete hain, tab aapko allot kiye gaye college mein jakar physical reporting karni hoti hai. Wahan college ki baaki bachi hui admission fee aur anya shulk (jo college ke niyam anusar ho) jama karne padte hain.
3. **Kitne rupaye lagenge:** Ye rashi har saal UPSFMAC ki guideline ke anusar tay hoti hai. Iski sahi jankari aapko apne **Allotment Letter** mein mil jayegi, jisme saaf likha hoga ki aapko kitni rashi online jama karni hai aur kitni college mein.

**Zaroori Salah:**
*   **Official Website:** Paise sirf aur sirf UPSFMAC ke official portal ([upsmfac.org](https://upsmfac.org)) par hi jama karein.
*   **Receipt:** Fee jama karne ke baad uski payment receipt (transaction slip) zaroor download kar lein aur uska printout apne paas rakhein.
*   **Caution:** Kisi bhi vyakti ko personal account mein ya kisi anjaan link par paise na bhejein.

Apne allotment letter ko dhyan se padhein, usme fee jama karne ki antim tithi (last date) aur tarika dono diye honge.

entries.question: Y kisi bi cafe se kra skte h online fees jma
entries.answer:
Haan, aap online fees kisi bhi jan-seva kendra (cyber cafe) ya apne ghar ke computer se jama kar sakte hain, lekin **in savdhaniyon ka palan zaroor karein**:

1.  **Official Portal:** Fee hamesha UPSFMAC ki official website ([upsmfac.org](https://upsmfac.org)) par hi jama karein. Cafe wale ko bolen ki woh sirf official website ka hi upyog kare.
2.  **Payment Method:** Apne samne hi payment karwayein. Ho sake toh apna khud ka ATM card, UPI, ya Net Banking ka upyog karein. Agar cafe wale ke card se payment kar rahe hain, toh ensure karein ki transaction success hone ke baad **"Payment Receipt"** ka printout turant nikal jaye.
3.  **Login Credentials:** Cafe wale ko apni login ID aur password batane ke baad, kaam khatam hone par apna password turant change kar lein.
4.  **Transaction ID:** Payment karne ke baad jo "Transaction ID" ya "Reference Number" generate hota hai, use note karke ya uska screenshot lekar apne phone mein zaroor save kar lein.
5.  **Confirm Karein:** Fee jama hone ke baad portal par login karke check karein ki wahan "Fee Paid" ya "Seat Confirmed" ka status dikha raha hai ya nahi.

**Ek zaroori baat:** Cyber cafe wale par puri tarah nirbhar na rahein. Payment ka process aapke samne hona chahiye taaki koi galti na ho aur aapka paisa sahi jagah pahunche. Kisi bhi anjaan ya suspicious link par click na karein.

entries.question: Or dd ka kya process h
entries.answer:
DD (Demand Draft) ka process admission ke liye bahut mahatvapurn hota hai. Agar aapko college ki taraf se DD banane ke liye kaha gaya hai, toh niche diye gaye steps ka palan karein:

### DD (Demand Draft) Kaise Banwayein:

1.  **Bank Jayein:** Apne nazdiki bank ki us branch mein jayein jahan aapka account hai (ya kisi bhi bade nationalized bank mein).
2.  **Form Bharein:** Bank mein "Demand Draft" ka ek form milta hai. Usme aapko nimn jankari bharne ko kaha jayega:
    *   **In Favour Of:** Yahan wo naam likhein jo aapke allotment letter ya college ke instruction mein diya gaya hai (e.g., "Principal, KGMU" ya "UPSFMAC, Lucknow"). **Ye naam bilkul sahi hona chahiye, ek spelling ki galti bhi DD ko invalid kar sakti hai.**
    *   **Amount:** Jitni fees DD ke roop mein mangi gayi hai, utni rashi (amount) bharin.
    *   **Payable At:** Wo shahar jahan ka DD banwana hai (jaise "Lucknow").
3.  **Payment:** Aap bank ko utni cash rashi denge ya apne account se katwayenge, sath hi bank ka apna processing charge (DD banwane ki fees) bhi lagega.
4.  **DD Prapt Karein:** Bank aapko ek paper dega, wahi "Demand Draft" hai. Is par bank ki seal aur authorized signatory ke sign hote hain.

### Kuch Zaroori Baatein:
*   **Spelling Check:** DD lene se pehle us par likhe huye naam aur amount ko allotment letter se zaroor match karein.
*   **Photocopy:** DD jama karne se pehle uski ek photocopy (ya photo) apne paas zaroor rakh lein.
*   **Security:** DD ek cheque ki tarah hota hai, ise sambhal kar rakhein. Is par "Account Payee" likha hona chahiye.
*   **Original Document:** Admission ke samay aapko DD ki original copy college mein submit karni hogi.

**Ek Salah:** Admission ke liye jane se pehle apne allotment letter ya college ke notice mein ye zaroor check kar lein ki kya unhone **DD mangi hai ya online payment**? Aajkal bahut se colleges online payment hi prefer karte hain, isliye DD banane se pehle confirm karna behtar hai.

Agar aapko college ki taraf se koi specific document ya link mila hai, toh usse verify kar lein.

entries.question: To abi jo 19000rupe lgege seat confirm krane k liye iski dd bnwani padegi yh firr cafe se kra skte h
entries.answer:
UPSFMAC (Uttar Pradesh State Medical Faculty) ki counseling mein **seat confirm karne ke liye ₹19,000 (ya jo bhi nirdharit rashi hai) ka bhugtan aamtaur par "Online" hi karna hota hai.**

Iske liye aapko DD (Demand Draft) banane ki zaroorat nahi hoti hai, balki aapko portal par **Online Payment** karna hota hai. Iske liye aap niche diye gaye tareeke apnayein:

### Online Fees Kaise Jama Karein:
1.  **UPSFMAC Portal:** Apne login se [upsmfac.org](https://upsmfac.org) par login karein.
2.  **Payment Option:** Wahan "Seat Acceptance Fee" ya "Pay Fee" ka option hoga.
3.  **Payment Mode:** Wahan aapko **UPI, Debit Card, Credit Card, ya Net Banking** ka option milega.
4.  **Cafe se Payment:** Ji haan, aap ye payment kisi bhi cyber cafe se karwa sakte hain, lekin:
    *   Payment karte waqt **apne samne** karwayein.
    *   Cafe wale ke personal UPI/Account se payment **na karwayein**. Apne khud ke bank account ya UPI (KGMU Pay/PhonePe) ka use karein.
    *   Payment hone ke turant baad **"Payment Receipt" (Transaction Slip)** ka printout nikalwayein. Ye receipt aapke admission ke samay bahut zaroori hogi.

### DD ki zaroorat kab padti hai?
DD ki zaroorat aamtaur par tab padti hai jab aap **physical reporting** ke liye college jate hain aur wahan baaki bachi hui college fees (tution fee, hostel fee, etc.) jama karni hoti hai. 

**Aapka agla kadam:**
1.  Apne **Allotment Letter** ko dhyan se padhein. Usme saaf likha hoga ki ₹19,000 ka bhugtan "Online" karna hai ya "DD" ke madhyam se.
2.  Agar allotment letter mein "Online Payment" likha hai, toh bilkul DD mat banwayein, sirf online payment karein.
3.  Agar aapko abhi bhi confusion hai, toh ek baar UPSFMAC ke official notification ya helpline number ko check kar lein.

**Chetawani:** Kisi bhi cafe wale ko apna password mat dijiye aur payment ka screenshot/receipt apne phone mein save zaroor rakhein.

entries.question: Phone se consult kr skte doctor se
entries.answer:
KGMU mein filhal doctor se seedhe phone par call karke consultation ki suvidha ke bajaye **Online Registration (ORS)** aur **Physical OPD** par adhik zor diya jata hai.

Telemedicine aur appointment se judi jankari niche di gayi hai:

1.  **Online Appointment (ORS):** Aap [https://ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in) par jakar apna registration aur appointment book kar sakte hain. Iske baad aapko hospital jakar doctor se milna hoga.
2.  **Helpline Numbers:** Yadi aapko kisi prakriya (process) ya appointment ke bare mein jankari chahiye, to aap in numbers par call kar sakte hain:
    *   **0522-2258880**
    *   **0522-3539333**
3.  **SMS Se Booking:** Aap `APPOINTMENT <NAME>` likhkar **8887019134** par SMS bhej sakte hain.

**Kuch Zaruri Batein:**
*   **OPD Timings:** Somwar se Shukrawar (9:00 AM – 1:00 PM) aur Shanivar (9:00 AM – 12:00 PM). Sunday ko OPD band rehti hai.
*   **Referral:** Yadi aap Lucknow ke bahar se aa rahe hain, to apne sath us vibhag (department) ka valid referral letter zaroor rakhein.
*   **Safety Warning:** Main ek AI chatbot hoon, isliye kripya chat mein apni personal jankari (jaise Aadhaar number, mobile number ya medical reports) share na karein.

Yadi aapko kisi bimari ke liye medical salah chahiye, to kripya KGMU ke OPD mein jakar kisi yogya doctor se sampark karein.

entries.question: Kya ors se appointment lekar direct doctor k pass ja skte

1. **OPD और अपॉइंटमेंट:** ऑनलाइन रजिस्ट्रेशन, समय और प्रक्रिया।
2. **कैंपस नेविगेशन:** विभिन्न विभागों या केंद्रों तक कैसे पहुँचें।

5. **संपर्क:** महत्वपूर्ण कार्यालयों या PRO के नंबर।

Halanki, KGMU ke official nirdeshon ke anusar:

1.  **Outside City Patients:** Lucknow ke bahar se aane wale mareezon ke liye referral letter lana ek surakshit aur sahi prakriya mani jati hai, taaki aapka samay kharab na ho aur aapko sahi vibhag (department) mein turant bheja ja sake.
2.  **General Medicine OPD:** Aksar jo mareez referral nahi late hain, unhein pehle **General Medicine OPD** mein bheja jata hai. Wahan ke doctors aapki jaanch karke yeh tay karte hain ki aapko kis super-specialty department (jaise Neurology, Cardiology, Urology, etc.) mein dikhane ki zarurat hai.
3.  **Badalte Niyam:** Hospital ki bheed (crowd) ko manage karne aur mareezon ko behtar suvidha dene ke liye samay-samay par niyam sakht kiye ja sakte hain. 

**Mera sujhav yeh hai:**
*   Yadi aapke paas referral nahi hai, toh aap **General Medicine OPD** ke counter par jayein. Wahan se aapko sahi disha mil jayegi ki aapko kis doctor ya department mein jana hai.

KGMU mein aap in departments mein se kisi ek mein dikha sakte hain:

1.  **Oral Medicine & Radiology:** Yeh department chehre aur jabde se judi samasyaon (jaise ki TMJ disorders, chronic pain, ya oral lesions) ke liye sabse sahi jagah hai. Yahan ke doctors aapka check-up karke bata sakte hain ki yeh samasya daanton ki hai, jabde ki hai, ya kisi aur karan se.
2.  **Oral & Maxillofacial Surgery:** Agar aapko lagta hai ki samasya jabde (jaw) ki haddiyon ya muscles se judi hai, toh aap is department mein dikha sakte hain.
3.  **Conservative Dentistry & Endodontics:** Agar aapko lagta hai ki yeh dard/bharipan sirf daanton ki kisi bimari (jaise ki infection ya cavity) ki wajah se hai, toh aap yahan dikha sakte hain.

*   **Pehle kahan jayein:** Mere hisaab se aapko **Oral Medicine & Radiology** department mein dikhana chahiye, kyunki wahan doctor aapke pure face aur jaws ka clinical examination karke sahi department refer kar denge ki aapko Surgery ki zarurat hai ya Dentistry ki.
*   **PRO Office:** Hospital pahunchkar aap PRO office ya registration counter par apni pareshani batayein, wo aapko sahi OPD room number bata denge.
*   **Purane Reports:** Agar aapne pehle koi X-ray ya scan karwaya hai, toh wo zaroor sath layein.

**Zaruri Baat:**
*   Jab tak aap doctor ko nahi dikhate, tab tak koi bhi dard-nivarak (painkiller) dawa khud se na lein.
*   KGMU ki OPD timings **subah 9:00 baje se dopahar 1:00 baje tak** hoti hain. Koshish karein ki aap subah jaldi pahunchein.

entries.question: 6 month se problem h
entries.answer:
Agar aapko yeh samasya **6 mahine se hai**, toh iska matlab hai ki yeh ek **Chronic (purani)** samasya hai. Is tarah ke mamlon mein doctor aksar aapka physical examination karne ke baad kuch specific **Imaging (X-ray ya OPG)** ya **Blood tests** karwane ki salah dete hain taaki problem ki jad tak pahuncha ja sake.

**6 mahine purani samasya ke liye aapko ye taiyari karke jani chahiye:**

1.  **History Note Karein:** Doctor aapse kuch sawal puch sakte hain, jaise:
    *   Kya yeh dard subah uthte waqt zyada hota hai?
    *   Kya khana chabate waqt jabde mein "khat-khat" (clicking sound) ki awaaz aati hai?
    *   Kya aapko stress ya neend mein daant peesne (teeth grinding) ki aadat hai?

entries.question: Dental me gye the lekin wha junior doctor ne dekha  usko smjh nhi aaya
entries.answer:
Yeh sunkar dukh hua ki aapko wahan sahi jawab nahi mila. Aksar bade hospitals mein bheed ki wajah se junior doctors ke paas samay kam hota hai, lekin KGMU mein iska samadhan hai. Agar junior doctor ko samajh nahi aaya, toh aap ye kadam utha sakte hain:

### 1. Senior Doctor (Professor/HOD) se Milyein
KGMU ke har department mein **Professor aur HOD (Head of Department)** hote hain jo bahut experienced hote hain. 
*   **Dobara jayein:** Jab aap agli baar jayein, toh counter par request karein ki aapko **"Senior Doctor"** ya **"Unit In-charge"** ko dikhana hai. 
*   **Parchi par likhwayein:** Agar junior doctor ko samajh nahi aa raha, toh aap unse shanti se keh sakte hain, *"Doctor sahab, kya aap ise kisi Senior Professor ko dikha sakte hain ya mujhe refer kar sakte hain?"*

### 2. "Oral Medicine & Radiology" Department
KGMU mein **Oral Medicine & Radiology** department ka kaam hi yahi hai ki wo aise cases ko pehchanein jo samajh nahi aa rahe. 
*   Agar aap kisi aur dental department (jaise sirf filling ya tooth extraction) mein gaye the, toh aap **Oral Medicine & Radiology** department mein hi jayein. Wahan ke doctors "Diagnosis" (bimari ki pehchan) ke expert hote hain.

### 3. Department Change ya "Multidisciplinary" Approach
Agar aapko lag raha hai ki gardan ka dard aur muh ki takleef judi hai, toh aap **PMR (Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation)** department mein bhi ek baar dikha sakte hain. Wahan ke doctors gardan aur sharir ke dard ke expert hote hain. 

### 4. Ek "Case Summary" Banayein
Doctor ko samjhane ke liye aap ek kagaz par ye baatein likh kar le jayein:
*   Dard kab shuru hua?
*   Dard kaisa hai? (Chubhan wala, bhari-pan, ya dhima dard)
*   Din mein kab badhta hai?
*   Kya koi dawa li thi? (Agar li thi, toh unke naam ya wrapper saath rakhein).
*   **Gardan ke dard ka zikr:** Saaf likhein ki "Muh ka dard aur gardan ka dard saath mein hota hai."

### 5. PRO Office ka Sahayta Lein
Agar aapko lag raha hai ki aapki baat nahi suni ja rahi, toh KGMU mein **PRO (Public Relations Officer) Office** hota hai. Aap wahan jakar apni shikayat ya samasya bata sakte hain. Wo aapko sahi jagah guide kar sakte hain.
*   **PRO Office Number (General):** 9415007710

**Mera sujhav:**
Aap himmat na harein. KGMU mein bahut bade-bade experts baithte hain. Agli baar jab jayein, toh **"Oral Medicine & Radiology"** department mein subah jaldi jakar senior professor ko dikhane ki zid karein. Aap unhe bata sakte hain ki aap Shahjahanpur se aaye hain aur aapko abhi tak sahi diagnosis nahi mila hai.

*Disclaimer: Main ek AI chatbot hoon, medical diagnosis nahi kar sakta. KGMU ke senior consultants hi aapki bimari ka sahi pata laga sakte hain. Apni report aur purane X-ray/MRI saath zaroor rakhein.*

entries.question: Oos ka number on line kaisey lagate hain
entries.answer:
KGMU में OPD के लिए ऑनलाइन पंजीकरण अनिवार्य है। आप नीचे दिए गए तरीकों से अपना नंबर (अपॉइंटमेंट) लगवा सकते हैं:

**1. ऑनलाइन माध्यम (ORS):**
*   वेबसाइट [https://ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in) पर जाएं।
*   'Registration/Login' पर क्लिक करें।
*   अपना मोबाइल नंबर और OTP दर्ज करें।
*   उत्तर प्रदेश राज्य और फिर KGMU का चयन करें।
*   विभागाध्यक्ष (Department), तिथि (Date) और समय चुनें।
*   मरीज का विवरण भरें और ₹50 का ऑनलाइन भुगतान करें।
*   पंजीकरण पर्ची (OPD Slip) डाउनलोड कर लें।

**2. SMS के माध्यम से:**
*   अपने मोबाइल से **`APPOINTMENT <मरीज का नाम>`** लिखकर **8887019134** पर भेजें।

**3. अन्य जानकारी:**
*   **OPD का समय:** सोमवार से शुक्रवार सुबह 9:00 बजे से दोपहर 1:00 बजे तक; शनिवार सुबह 9:00 बजे से 12:00 बजे तक। रविवार को OPD बंद रहती है।
*   **पर्ची शुल्क:** सभी बुकिंग माध्यमों के लिए ₹50 का शुल्क है।
*   **महत्वपूर्ण:** यदि आप शहर से बाहर के मरीज हैं, तो संबंधित विभाग के लिए वैध रेफरल (Referral) पत्र साथ जरूर लाएं।

अस्पताल आने पर अपनी ऑनलाइन पर्ची और आधार कार्ड साथ रखें। भीड़ से बचने के लिए पहले से अपॉइंटमेंट बुक करना उचित रहता है।

entries.question: Dr se online bat kaise karen

KGMU में डॉक्टरों से सीधे ऑनलाइन बात करने (वीडियो कॉल या चैट) की कोई आधिकारिक सुविधा उपलब्ध नहीं है। KGMU में इलाज के लिए मरीज का शारीरिक रूप से उपस्थित होना अनिवार्य है।

ऑनलाइन परामर्श के बजाय आप निम्नलिखित प्रक्रियाओं का पालन कर सकते हैं:

1.  **OPD अपॉइंटमेंट लें:** यदि आपको किसी विशेष समस्या के लिए डॉक्टर से मिलना है, तो आप ऊपर बताए गए तरीके (ORS पोर्टल) से ऑनलाइन अपॉइंटमेंट बुक करें और अस्पताल के संबंधित विभाग में जाकर डॉक्टर को दिखाएं।
2.  **OPD का समय:** अस्पताल में OPD सुबह 9:00 बजे से दोपहर 1:00 बजे तक (शनिवार को 12:00 बजे तक) चलती है।
3.  **हेल्पलाइन:** यदि आपको किसी विभाग या डॉक्टर की उपलब्धता के बारे में जानकारी चाहिए, तो आप KGMU की हेल्पलाइन **0522-2258880** या **0522-3539333** पर कॉल कर सकते हैं।

**सावधानी:** मैं एक AI हूँ और चिकित्सा सलाह देने के लिए योग्य नहीं हूँ। कृपया अपनी स्वास्थ्य संबंधी समस्याओं के लिए किसी डॉक्टर से व्यक्तिगत रूप से मिलें। साथ ही, किसी भी अनजान व्यक्ति को अपनी स्वास्थ्य रिपोर्ट या व्यक्तिगत जानकारी साझा न करें।

**सलाह:** कृपया किसी भी अनौपचारिक व्यक्ति या बिचौलिए के झांसे में न आएं। KGMU में मेडिकल स्टोर या किसी भी सेवा का आवंटन पूरी तरह से पारदर्शी टेंडर प्रक्रिया के माध्यम से ही किया जाता है। आप आधिकारिक वेबसाइट के अलावा किसी अन्य स्रोत पर भरोसा न करें।

entries.question: Pulmonary & Critical Care Medicine department me online kaise karu
entries.answer:
KGMU mein OPD ke liye online registration karna mandatory hai. Aap Pulmonary & Critical Care Medicine (PCCM) department ke liye niche diye gaye tarikon se appointment book kar sakte hain:

**1. Online Appointment Booking (ORS):**
*   **Website:** [https://ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in) par jayein.
*   **Process:** Login/Register karein → Uttar Pradesh select karein → KGMU select karein → 'New Appointment' par click karein → Pulmonary & Critical Care Medicine department aur date select karein → Patient ki details bharein → ₹50 ka online payment karein aur slip download kar lein.

**2. ABHA / Health Care App:**
*   Aap apne mobile number aur OTP ka upyog karke register kar sakte hain aur upar di gayi process ko follow kar sakte hain.

**3. SMS dwara:**
*   Aap `APPOINTMENT <NAME>` likhkar **8887019134** par SMS bhej sakte hain.

**Kuch Zaroori Baatein:**
*   **OPD Timings:** Somvar se Shukravar (9:00 AM – 1:00 PM) aur Shanivar (9:00 AM – 12:00 PM). Sunday ko OPD band rehti hai.
*   **Referral:** Agar aap Lucknow ke bahar se hain, toh kripya us department ka valid referral letter saath layein.
*   **Parchi Counter:** OPD slip ka shulk ₹50 hai. Parchi counter dopahar 1:00 baje sharp band ho jata hai, isliye samay se pahunchna behtar hai.
*   **Safety:** I'm not qualified to provide medical advice. Please consult a doctor at KGMU OPD or call the helpline. Also, please avoid sharing personal details in this chat for your safety.

Pre-booking ki salah di jati hai taaki lambe intezar (wait time) se bacha ja sake.
